metadata.title: Ezekiel
metadata.subtitle: Ezekiel 1:1 – 48:35 (139 questions)
metadata.description: Questions on the Book of Ezekiel according to the King James Version (1769).
metadata.author: King James Version (1769)

questions.text: Unto what is the Assyrian likened in Ezekiel 31:3?

options.text: Unto a great oak of Bashan with deep and unmovable roots
Unto a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches and high stature
Unto an olive tree whose branches spread across the valley
Unto a fruitful fig tree yielding abundant sweet fruit in due time

questions.text: Why was the great cedar delivered unto the hand of the mighty (Ezekiel 31:10)?

options.text: Because worms had devoured its bark and withered its greenery
Because lightning from heaven had struck its topmost branch down
Because he lifted up himself in height and his heart was proud
Because he gave shade unto strange beasts that God had forbidden

questions.text: What was the effect of the cedar's fall in Ezekiel 31:16?

options.text: The whole forest rejoiced and all trees clapped their hands
The kings of the earth gathered its wood for their royal ships
A great drought fell upon the waters of Lebanon for seven years
I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall into pit

questions.text: What does the Lord GOD declare unto Pharaoh in Ezekiel 32:3?

options.text: I will spread out my net over thee; they shall bring thee up
I will set a royal crown of gold upon thy head before the world
I will send sweet rain upon thy land and bless all thy harvests
I will make thy border strong against the proud armies of Asshur

questions.text: Who is described as lying in the pit with her graves round about (Ezekiel 32:22)?

options.text: The princes of Tyre and the seafaring merchants of the west
Asshur and all her company, all of them slain, fallen by sword
The ancient kings of Canaan who fought Joshua in the valleys
The rebellious house of Israel that perished in the wilderness

questions.text: Over what shall Pharaoh be comforted when he sees them in the pit (Ezekiel 32:31)?

options.text: Over the treasures of silver and gold that were buried with him
Over his sons and daughters who escaped into a distant country
Over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and his army slain by sword
Over the remembrance of his mighty deeds and glorious monuments

questions.text: What solemn oath does the Lord GOD swear in Ezekiel 33:11?

options.text: As I live, I am a God of fury and will show no mercy to the wicked
As I live, I will punish every transgressor and none shall escape
As I live, I will forgive all sins without repentance of the soul
I have no pleasure in death of wicked; but that he turn and live

questions.text: How did the people receive Ezekiel's words according to Ezekiel 33:31?

options.text: They hear thy words, but they will not do them
They heard them and immediately repented of sin
They mocked at the prophet and cast him in prison
They trembled with fear and fled out of the city

questions.text: What woe does the Lord GOD pronounce in Ezekiel 34:2?

options.text: Woe to the kings of the earth that usurp the throne
Woe be to the shepherds of Israel that feed themselves!
Woe to the priests of the altar that take holy gifts
Woe to the prophets of deceit that speak vain visions

questions.text: Whom will the LORD set up as one shepherd over His flock (Ezekiel 34:23)?

options.text: A faithful priest of God
A mighty prince of Levi
Even his servant David
An angel from heaven

questions.text: Against what mountain was Ezekiel commanded to set his face in Ezekiel 35:2?

options.text: Against Mount Hermon in the north
Against Mount Carmel by the sea
Against Mount Sinai in desert
Against Mount Seir in Edom

questions.text: What attitude did Edom have toward the children of Israel (Ezekiel 35:5)?

options.text: A perpetual hatred, shedding blood by force of sword in calamity
A quiet envy, refusing to buy merchandise from the sons of Jacob
A false friendship, pretending peace while taking secret counsel
A bitter mockery, laughing at their holy worship in the temple

questions.text: What boast did Edom make in Ezekiel 35:10?

options.text: Our princes shall rule over all the coasts of the Great Sea
These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, possess it
The temple of Jerusalem shall be given to our priests forever
No foreign empire shall ever set foot upon the cliffs of Seir

questions.text: What does the LORD promise unto the mountains of Israel in Ezekiel 36:8?

options.text: They shall be enriched with silver and precious stones of Ophir
Their heights shall be fortified with invincible iron battlements
Ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield fruit to my people
They shall smoke with holy incense before the throne of God

questions.text: How will the LORD sprinkle and cleanse His people in Ezekiel 36:25?

options.text: With the blood of spotless bulls and rams upon the holy altar
With sweet and precious oil of anointing from the tabernacle
With fine flour of wheat mixed with holy salt before the LORD
I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean

questions.text: What does the LORD promise to give His people in Ezekiel 36:26?

options.text: A new heart and new spirit, taking away the stony heart of flesh
Victory over all earthly monarchs and an everlasting crown of gold
Immunity from all diseases, pestilence, and famine in their land
An earthly paradise flowing with milk and honey without any work

questions.text: What design does Gog form in his mind according to Ezekiel 38:11?

options.text: To build a mighty navy and lay siege to the great island of Tyre
To conquer the royal house of Pharaoh and seize all the gold of Egypt
To send gifts of friendship unto the kings of the far north country
I will go to the land of unwalled villages, to take a spoil and prey

questions.text: Where shall the host of Gog fall according to Ezekiel 39:4?

options.text: Upon the mountains of Israel
In the wilderness by the sea
In the valley of Jehoshaphat
Before the gates of Babylon

questions.text: How long shall the cities of Israel burn the weapons for fuel (Ezekiel 39:9)?

options.text: Three years and six months
Seven years they burn them
Twelve years without ceasing
Forty days in solemn memory

questions.text: How long shall the house of Israel be burying the slain to cleanse the land (Ezekiel 39:12)?

options.text: Three months shall they bury
Forty days shall they bury
Seven months shall they bury
One full year shall they bury

questions.text: In what year of their captivity did Ezekiel see the vision of the temple (Ezekiel 40:1)?

options.text: In the fortieth year thereof
In the fourteenth year thereof
In the thirtieth year thereof
In the five and twentieth year

questions.text: What was the appearance of the man who guided Ezekiel in Ezekiel 40:3?

options.text: Like appearance of brass, with line of flax and measuring reed
Clothed in fine white linen, with a golden crown upon his head
Like a burning flame of fire, with a silver trumpet in his hand
Like an ancient priest, with holy incense and oil in a golden bowl

questions.text: What was the length of the measuring reed in Ezekiel 40:5?

options.text: Three cubits, each cubit being a hand breadth shorter than common
Six cubits long by the cubit and an hand breadth in the man's hand
Ten cubits, each cubit being a hand breadth longer than common
Twelve cubits, each cubit being exactly the common length of man

questions.text: Which priests had charge of the altar according to Ezekiel 40:46?

options.text: The sons of Phinehas among the sons of Eleazar
The sons of Gershon among the families of Levi
The sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi
The sons of Ithamar among the houses of Aaron

questions.text: What was the breadth of the posts of the temple in Ezekiel 41:1?

options.text: Three cubits broad on the one side and three on the other
Four cubits broad on the one side and four on the other
Ten cubits broad on the one side and ten on the other
Six cubits broad on the one side, and six on the other

questions.text: What figures were carved upon the temple walls in Ezekiel 41:18-19?

options.text: Cherubims and palm trees, every cherub having two faces
Lions and oxen, with golden eagles spreading wings above
Pomegranates and lilies, with golden chains of work round about
Grape clusters and olive boughs, with figures of holy angels

questions.text: What was the altar of wood called in Ezekiel 41:22?

options.text: The golden hearth of incense before the veil
This is the table that is before the LORD
The holy memorial altar of the covenant
The consecrated place of burnt offerings

questions.text: What were the priests to do in the holy chambers of Ezekiel 42:13?

options.text: Anoint the sacred vessels with oil before bringing into temple
Cast the sacred lots to determine the courses of the sanctuary
Eat the most holy things and lay the offerings and sin offering
Wash their garments seven times in pure water before sunset

questions.text: What was the measure of the wall around the sanctuary in Ezekiel 42:20?

options.text: A hundred reeds on every side
A thousand cubits on each side
Three hundred reeds on every side
Five hundred reeds on every side

questions.text: From what direction did the glory of the God of Israel come (Ezekiel 43:2)?

options.text: From the way of the east
From the way of the north
From the way of the south
From the way of the west

questions.text: What did the voice of the LORD declare concerning the temple in Ezekiel 43:7?

options.text: This is the house of prayer for all nations under the sun
The place of my throne, where I will dwell in midst of Israel forever
The mountain of my holiness, which shall never be touched by hand
The sanctuary of my glory, which shall outshine all the stars

questions.text: How many days were they to purge and purify the altar in Ezekiel 43:26?

options.text: Three days were they to purge
Forty days were they to purge
Seven days shall they purge
Twelve days were they to purge

questions.text: Why was the east gate of the outer sanctuary to be shut (Ezekiel 44:2)?

options.text: Lest any stranger or foreigner should pollute the holy court
Until the prince should enter in to offer his burnt sacrifice
Because the foundation of the gate was shaken by an earthquake
Because the LORD, the God of Israel, hath entered in by it

questions.text: Who was permitted to come near unto the LORD to minister unto Him (Ezekiel 44:15)?

options.text: The priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok
All the sons of Levi who remained in the land
The elders of the people from all twelve tribes
The prophets who prophesied truth in Israel

questions.text: What garments were the priests to wear in the inner court (Ezekiel 44:17)?

options.text: Garments of pure blue wool, embroidered with fine golden thread
Clothed with linen garments; no wool shall come upon them
Garments of sackcloth and haircloth during the solemn assemblies
Robes of purple and fine silk adorned with precious onyx stones

questions.text: What portion was to be offered as an holy oblation unto the LORD (Ezekiel 45:1)?

options.text: A portion of ten thousand reeds in length and five thousand broad
A square portion of twelve thousand cubits on every quarter
An holy portion: length of five and twenty thousand, breadth ten thousand
A round portion surrounding the whole mountain of the temple

questions.text: What does the Lord GOD command the princes of Israel in Ezekiel 45:9?

options.text: Build strong walls and prepare great store of spears and shields
Collect a rich tribute from all the foreign nations round about
Make an holy alliance with the faithful governors of the north
Remove violence and spoil, and execute judgment and justice

questions.text: What feast is to be kept on the fourteenth day of the first month (Ezekiel 45:21)?

options.text: The feast of the passover
The feast of tabernacles
The joyful feast of weeks
The sacred feast of trumpets

questions.text: When shall the gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east be opened (Ezekiel 46:1)?

options.text: On every morning of the week
On the sabbath and new moon
On all the days of passover
Only on the day of atonement

questions.text: What rule governed entering and leaving by the gates in solemn feasts (Ezekiel 46:9)?

options.text: Every man must go out by the same gate wherein he entered in
The prince alone shall enter by the east and go out by the west
He that entereth by north gate goeth out by south, and vice versa
All people must enter by the south and leave through the north

questions.text: What was the purpose of the places in the corners of the court (Ezekiel 46:24)?

options.text: To wash the sacred vestments of the priests before the sacrifice
To store the wheat, oil, and wine brought as tithes by people
To keep the wood and holy fire prepared for the burnt offering
Where the ministers of the house shall boil sacrifice of people

questions.text: How did the depth of the waters increase as measured in Ezekiel 47:3-5?

options.text: To ankles, to knees, to loins, then a river that could not be passed
To knees, to thighs, to shoulders, then overflowing all the land
To ankles, to breast, to chin, then a raging sea without an harbor
To calves, to waist, to head, then sweeping away all living trees

questions.text: How shall the strangers that sojourn among them be treated (Ezekiel 47:22)?

options.text: As hired servants without rights, possessing no land of their own
As born in country among children of Israel; shall have inheritance
As tributary subjects who must pay a double tithe unto the priests
As dwellers in the outer cities who may not approach the temple

questions.text: How shall the gates of the city be named according to Ezekiel 48:31?

options.text: After the four quarters of heaven
After the holy prophets of God
After the names of the tribes of Israel
After the families of the priests

questions.text: With whom did Aholibah (Jerusalem) dote in her whoredoms (Ezekiel 23:12-16)?

options.text: Upon the Egyptians and Philistines, sending ambassadors unto them
Upon the Moabites and Ammonites, worshipping their strange idols
Upon the Assyrians and Chaldeans, seeing men pourtrayed on wall
Upon the Syrians and Phoenicians, whose merchant ships enticed her
